title: GSE Grammar Inventory And Inflection-Level Identity
description: Acquire the Pearson GSE Grammar inventory, graph it as the independently gated enrichment layer enrichment.gse.grammar, specify inflection-level identity, and make recommendation matching inflection-aware under a new contract version.
deviation_notes: Opened 2026-08-11 from the recommendation Phase 4 independent review. Cambridge lists are lemma-only, so inflected forms carry no level and classify as hard unmatched vocabulary; 8 of 18 unmatched spans in the recommendation fixture pack are inflections of listed lemmas. Naive lemma mapping is unsafe because `be` spans pre-A1 to about B2.
closes_tech_debt: Matching applies no lemmatization, so inflected forms count as hard unmatched vocabulary
Identity has a third unaddressed axis: inflection and tense
